content.text: MY-CAR is a convenient online service for tracking repairs and maintaining your vehicle. Every owner can keep a detailed history of expenses for their transport: when and what repairs were done, which parts were installed, how much it cost, and much more. After registration, you will get access to your personal account and the 'My Garage' page, where you can:
content.list1: Create entries for repairs, parts replacement, and maintenance;
content.list2: Specify brands, mileage, dates, and costs;
content.list4: Choose one of three plans according to your needs;
content.list5: Update personal data, change password, or delete your account entirely with all data.

tariffsSection.title: Service Plans
tariffsSection.text: Choose the plan that best fits your needs.

card1.title: Basic
card1.text: The plan provides access to core features but allows creating records for only one vehicle.

card2.title: Family
card2.text: The plan allows creating records for up to 5 vehicles, includes basic statistics and reports, and is ad-free.

card3.title: Business
card3.text: The plan offers unlimited vehicles, full feature access, advanced statistics, priority support, and no ads.
